**Dealmed** is a major independent medical and surgical supply distributor in the United States. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, the company supplies medical equipment, pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and everyday office consumables to healthcare facilities nationwide. [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dealmed)

- **Medical Supplies:** Exam room consumables, PPE, gloves, infection control items, wound care, and diagnostic tools.

- **Pharmaceuticals & Vaccines:** Routine and seasonal medications, including annual flu vaccine pre-bookings and distributions.

- **Logistics & 3PL:** End-to-end supply chain solutions, warehousing, inventory management, and group purchasing organization (GPO) contract matching for medical practices. [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dealmed)

### Who They Serve

- Hospitals and major healthcare systems

- Private physician and specialist offices

- Urgent care and community health centers

- Dialysis and outpatient surgical centers

- EMS and first responders [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dealmed)
